q24390.en: The helmet ages because of light and heat.

explain.short: Sunlight and heat slowly weaken the materials of the helmet. An old helmet protects less.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'invecchiamento' (ageing): a helmet does not last forever.

sceneParams.caption: Light and heat slowly age the helmet
lines: Motorcycle helmet in sun and heat

q24391.en: The helmet must be cleaned with non-corrosive detergents.

explain.short: Strong chemicals can damage the shell. Use only mild, non-corrosive soap.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'non corrosivi' (not corrosive): only gentle products.

sceneParams.caption: Clean the helmet with mild soap only

q24392.en: The helmet must not be cleaned with solvents.

explain.short: Solvents can attack the plastic of the shell and make it weaker, even if you cannot see it.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'non deve' with 'solventi': solvents are forbidden for cleaning.

sceneParams.caption: Never clean the helmet with solvents

q24393.en: The helmet must not be cleaned with petrol.

explain.short: Petrol is a solvent: it attacks the shell and makes the helmet weaker.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'benzina' (petrol): a common trap, never use it on a helmet.

sceneParams.caption: Never clean the helmet with petrol

q24394.en: Using the helmet is necessary to reduce the effects of any blows to the head.

explain.short: In a fall the head can hit the road. The helmet absorbs the blow and reduces head injuries.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'ridurre gli effetti' (reduce the effects): this is the main job of the helmet.

sceneParams.caption: The helmet reduces head injuries

q24395.en: The full-face helmet also protects the face from trauma and injuries in an accident.

explain.short: A full-face helmet (casco integrale) covers the chin and face too, so it protects them in a crash.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'integrale' (full-face): it covers the whole head, face included.

sceneParams.caption: A full-face helmet protects the face too
lines: Fewer face injuries in a crash

q24396.en: It is good for the helmet to have a visor.

explain.short: The visor protects the eyes and face from wind, rain, insects and stones. So it is useful.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'E' bene' (it is good): advice, and correct advice.

sceneParams.caption: A helmet with a visor is better
lines: Protects eyes from wind and insects

q24397.en: The helmet visor protects the face and eyes from hitting insects.

explain.short: At speed an insect hits like a small stone. The visor stops it before it reaches the eyes.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'insetti' (insects): a real danger for the eyes at speed.

sceneParams.caption: The visor stops insects hitting your eyes

q24398.en: The helmet must be the correct size.

explain.short: A helmet that is too big moves or comes off in a fall. Too small is uncomfortable. It must fit well.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'taglia corretta' (correct size): a wrong size protects badly.

sceneParams.caption: Choose a helmet of the right size
lines: Too big: it moves in a fall

q24399.en: The helmet must be replaced after a strong blow, even if the outer shell shows no deformation.

explain.short: A strong blow can break the inside padding even if the outside looks fine. Then it no longer protects well.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'anche se non mostra deformazioni' (even if it shows no damage): damage can be hidden.

sceneParams.caption: After a strong blow, replace the helmet

keywords.en: even if it shows no deformation

q24400.en: The strength of the helmet's outer shell could be weakened by solvents in paints or glues.

explain.short: Paints and glues contain solvents. They can attack the shell, so do not paint or glue things on it.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'vernici o colle' (paints or glues): they contain solvents too.

sceneParams.caption: Paints and glues can weaken the shell
lines: Paint or glue on the helmet

q24401.en: While riding, the helmet must always be correctly fastened.

explain.short: An unfastened helmet can fly off in a fall. It must be fastened every time the vehicle moves.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'sempre correttamente allacciato' (always correctly fastened): no exceptions.

sceneParams.caption: Always fasten the helmet strap
lines: Strap not fastened: helmet flies off

q24402.en: Wearing the helmet in the wrong way, or without fastening it correctly, can cause serious health risks in a fall or accident.

explain.short: A helmet that is badly worn or not fastened can come off or move. Then the head is not protected.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'in modo errato' (in the wrong way): a badly worn helmet is almost like no helmet.

sceneParams.caption: A loose helmet does not protect you
lines: It comes off in a fall

q24403.en: The helmet must be worn even for short trips and at low speed.

explain.short: Falls also happen on short trips and at low speed. The helmet is compulsory on every trip.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'anche' (even): short trips and low speed are not exceptions.

sceneParams.caption: Helmet on every trip, even short and slow
lines: Low speed is not an exception

q24404.en: The helmet must be worn also on motor quadricycles without bodywork (Quad).

explain.short: A quad has no cabin, so the rider is as exposed as on a motorcycle. The helmet is compulsory.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'privi di carrozzeria' (without bodywork): no cabin means helmet.

sceneParams.caption: Quad without bodywork: helmet compulsory
lines: Rider exposed like on a motorcycle

q24405.en: The helmet visor must be replaced if it is scratched or damaged.

explain.short: Scratches spread the light and reduce what you see, especially at night or in the rain. Replace the visor.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'rigata' (scratched): even small scratches spoil the view.

sceneParams.caption: Scratched visor: replace it
lines: Poor view at night and in rain

q24406.en: The helmet visor must give perfect vision in any light or lighting conditions.

explain.short: You must see well by day, at night and against bright lights. The visor must be clear, not scratched.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'qualunque condizione di luce' (any light conditions): day and night.

sceneParams.caption: The visor must give clear vision always
lines: Visor by day and at night

q24407.en: The helmet ventilation system helps limit the risk of the visor fogging up.

explain.short: Breath makes the visor fog up. Air vents move the air and keep the visor clear.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'appannamento' (fogging): the vents fight it.

sceneParams.caption: Helmet vents keep the visor clear

q24408.en: A driver who does not wear the helmet loses points from the driving licence.

explain.short: Riding without a helmet is a serious offence: you get a fine and points are taken off your licence.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'decurtazione di punti' (points taken off): yes, this offence costs points.

sceneParams.caption: No helmet: fine and licence points lost

q24409.en: Any kind of sticker can be put on the helmet, as long as it does not cover the visor.

explain.short: Stickers can contain glues with solvents that weaken the shell. So not just any sticker is allowed.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'di qualunque tipo' (of any kind): too broad, stickers can damage the shell.

sceneParams.caption: Not any sticker: glues can weaken the shell

q24410.en: The helmet must be cleaned regularly with petrol or white spirit to degrease it and remove insect remains.

explain.short: Petrol and white spirit (acquaragia) are solvents. They damage the shell. Use mild soap and water.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'benzina o acquaragia' (petrol or white spirit): exactly what you must never use.

sceneParams.caption: Never petrol or white spirit: use mild soap

q24412.en: The helmet must be fully fastened only on roads outside towns.

explain.short: The helmet must always be fastened, in town and outside towns. Most falls happen in town.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only): the rule is 'always', everywhere.

sceneParams.caption: Fasten the helmet everywhere, not only outside towns

q24413.en: When riding in controlled speed zones below 30 km/h, the helmet is not compulsory.

explain.short: The helmet is compulsory at any speed and in any zone. A fall at 30 km/h can still hurt your head badly.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'non è obbligatorio' (not compulsory): wrong, low-speed zones are not an exception.

sceneParams.caption: Helmet compulsory in 30 km/h zones too

q24414.en: The helmet is compulsory on any motor quadricycle.

explain.short: Only quadricycles without bodywork (like quads) need a helmet. A microcar with a closed cabin does not.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'qualunque' (any): too broad, closed-cabin quadricycles are exempt.

sceneParams.caption: Helmet only on quadricycles without bodywork

q24415.en: The helmet keeps its protective features unchanged for very long periods, over twenty years.

explain.short: Light and heat age the helmet. Its protection gets weaker with time, so it cannot last twenty years.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'invariate' (unchanged): the helmet ages, it does not stay the same.

sceneParams.caption: Helmets age: they do not last 20 years

q24416.en: The full-face helmet cannot be used when riding in busy urban centres.

explain.short: A full-face helmet is allowed everywhere, in town too. It gives the best protection.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'non può essere utilizzato' (cannot be used): no such ban exists.

sceneParams.caption: Full-face helmet is allowed in town too

q24417.en: The full-face helmet is useless when riding a two-wheeled moped.

explain.short: A moped rider can fall and hit the face too. The full-face helmet protects the face on any two-wheeler.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'inutile' (useless): it is useful on a moped too.

sceneParams.caption: Full-face helmet is useful on a moped too
lines: Face can hit the ground in a fall

q24418.en: The obligation to wear a helmet does not apply to adults with more than three years of driving experience.

explain.short: The helmet is compulsory for everyone on a moped or motorcycle. Age and experience change nothing.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'non riguarda' (does not apply to): there is no exemption for experienced adults.

sceneParams.caption: Helmet for everyone, even expert riders

q24419.en: Using the helmet while riding becomes optional when the air temperature is above thirty degrees.

explain.short: The helmet is compulsory in any weather. Heat is not an exception.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'facoltativo' (optional): the helmet is never optional.

sceneParams.caption: Helmet compulsory even in hot weather

q24420.en: The helmet visor greatly worsens visibility, so it should be used as little as possible.

explain.short: A clean visor does not spoil your view. It protects your eyes, so you should use it.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'il meno possibile' (as little as possible): wrong, the visor should be used.

sceneParams.caption: Use the visor: it protects your eyes

q24421.en: The helmet shell can be repaired with special adhesive tape if the crack is smaller than three centimetres.

explain.short: A cracked shell no longer protects. Tape does not fix it: the helmet must be replaced.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'riparata con nastro adesivo' (repaired with tape): a helmet is never repaired, it is replaced.

sceneParams.caption: Cracked shell: replace the helmet, no tape

q24422.en: The helmet visor can be repaired with adhesive tape, as long as it is ultra-transparent.

explain.short: Tape on the visor spoils your view. A damaged visor must be replaced, not repaired.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'purché' (as long as): no kind of tape makes it OK.

sceneParams.caption: Damaged visor: replace it, no tape

q24423.en: Helmets used for riding mopeds do not need approval.

explain.short: Helmets for mopeds must be approved (omologati) too, like those for motorcycles.
explain.rule: On mopeds and motorcycles the driver and the passenger must always wear an approved helmet of the right size, correctly fastened, on every trip. No exceptions for speed, short trips, heat, age or experience.
explain.trap: 'non necessitano di omologazione' (do not need approval): wrong, all helmets must be approved.

sceneParams.caption: Moped helmets must be approved too

q24424.en: Motorcycle boots give proper protection to feet and ankles when riding a two-wheeled vehicle.

explain.short: Motorcycle boots are made to protect feet and ankles in a fall or impact.
explain.rule: Motorcycle boots are approved (omologati) safety boots: they protect feet and ankles from impacts, twisting, cold and asphalt, and have no loose laces.
explain.trap: 'giusta protezione' (proper protection): this is what they are for.

sceneParams.caption: Motorcycle boots protect feet and ankles

q24425.en: Motorcycle boots reduce the effects of sprains if you put your feet down badly, and protect the ankle joints from cold.

explain.short: The stiff boot holds the ankle if you put your foot down badly, and keeps it warm.
explain.rule: Motorcycle boots are approved (omologati) safety boots: they protect feet and ankles from impacts, twisting, cold and asphalt, and have no loose laces.
explain.trap: 'distorsioni' (sprains) and 'freddo' (cold): both are real protections.

sceneParams.caption: Boots protect ankles from sprains and cold
lines: Foot put down badly when stopping

q24426.en: Motorcycle boots have no loose straps or laces, so they do not catch on the motorcycle's levers.

explain.short: Loose laces can catch on the gear lever or footrests and cause a fall. So motorcycle boots have none.
explain.rule: Motorcycle boots are approved (omologati) safety boots: they protect feet and ankles from impacts, twisting, cold and asphalt, and have no loose laces.
explain.trap: 'privi di nastri liberi o stringhe' (no loose straps or laces): safer on the pedals.

sceneParams.caption: No loose laces: they cannot catch
lines: They can catch and cause a fall

q24427.en: Motorcycle boots protect the feet from scraping on the asphalt in a fall.

explain.short: In a fall the feet can slide on the road. Strong boots stop the asphalt from scraping the skin.
explain.rule: Motorcycle boots are approved (omologati) safety boots: they protect feet and ankles from impacts, twisting, cold and asphalt, and have no loose laces.
explain.trap: 'abrasioni' (scrapes): boots protect against them.

sceneParams.caption: Boots protect feet from scraping on asphalt

q24428.en: Motorcycle boots are approved according to international standards.

explain.short: Real motorcycle boots are tested and approved (omologati) to international standards.
explain.rule: Motorcycle boots are approved (omologati) safety boots: they protect feet and ankles from impacts, twisting, cold and asphalt, and have no loose laces.
explain.trap: 'omologati' (approved): yes, there is an official approval.

sceneParams.caption: Motorcycle boots are approved

q24429.en: Shoes approved for motorcycle use are designed not to come off in a fall.

explain.short: A boot that comes off leaves the foot unprotected. Approved boots are made to stay on.
explain.rule: Motorcycle boots are approved (omologati) safety boots: they protect feet and ankles from impacts, twisting, cold and asphalt, and have no loose laces.
explain.trap: 'non scalzarsi' (not come off): they stay on the foot.

sceneParams.caption: Approved boots stay on in a fall

q24430.en: Instead of motorcycle boots you can use high-mountain hiking shoes, because they have a similar design.

explain.short: Hiking shoes are made for walking, not for riding. They have laces and are not approved for motorcycles.
explain.rule: Motorcycle boots are approved (omologati) safety boots: they protect feet and ankles from impacts, twisting, cold and asphalt, and have no loose laces.
explain.trap: 'di analoga concezione' (similar design): false, they are made for something else.

sceneParams.caption: Hiking shoes are not motorcycle boots

q24431.en: Motorcycle boots have double laces to stop them coming off.

explain.short: Motorcycle boots have no laces at all, because laces can catch on the levers.
explain.rule: Motorcycle boots are approved (omologati) safety boots: they protect feet and ankles from impacts, twisting, cold and asphalt, and have no loose laces.
explain.trap: 'doppie stringhe' (double laces): they have no laces.

sceneParams.caption: Motorcycle boots have no laces
lines: Laces can catch on the levers

q24432.en: Motorcycle boots have a steel sole.

explain.short: A steel sole would be heavy and slippery. Motorcycle boots have a strong, grippy sole, not steel.
explain.rule: Motorcycle boots are approved (omologati) safety boots: they protect feet and ankles from impacts, twisting, cold and asphalt, and have no loose laces.
explain.trap: 'in acciaio' (steel): invented detail.

sceneParams.caption: No steel sole on motorcycle boots

q24433.en: Motorcycle boots cover the leg up above the knee to protect the rider better in a fall.

explain.short: Motorcycle boots protect feet, ankles and lower leg. They do not go above the knee, so you can bend it.
explain.rule: Motorcycle boots are approved (omologati) safety boots: they protect feet and ankles from impacts, twisting, cold and asphalt, and have no loose laces.
explain.trap: 'fin sopra il ginocchio' (above the knee): too high.

sceneParams.caption: Boots do not go above the knee

q24434.en: Motorcycle boots must be made entirely of fireproof rubber.

explain.short: Motorcycle boots are made of strong materials like leather, with protections. They are not all rubber.
explain.rule: Motorcycle boots are approved (omologati) safety boots: they protect feet and ankles from impacts, twisting, cold and asphalt, and have no loose laces.
explain.trap: 'interamente' (entirely) and 'gomma' (rubber): invented rule.

sceneParams.caption: Boots are not all rubber

q24435.en: There are no specific motorcycle boots, so it is good to use strong shoes like those for hunting, fishing or climbing.

explain.short: Specific motorcycle boots do exist and are approved. Hunting or climbing shoes are not the same.
explain.rule: Motorcycle boots are approved (omologati) safety boots: they protect feet and ankles from impacts, twisting, cold and asphalt, and have no loose laces.
explain.trap: 'Non esistono' (do not exist): they do exist.

sceneParams.caption: Motorcycle boots exist: use them

q24436.en: When riding mopeds or motorcycles it is advisable to use protective gloves for the hands.

explain.short: In a fall you put your hands down first. Gloves protect them, so they are recommended.
explain.rule: Motorcycle gloves are approved (omologati): they protect the back of the hand and the palm, give a safe grip and good feel on the controls, and are useful all year.
explain.trap: 'consigliabile' (advisable): it is good advice.

sceneParams.caption: Wear protective gloves on two wheels

q24437.en: Approved motorcycle gloves especially protect the back of the hand from impacts with hard objects.

explain.short: Approved gloves have hard protection on the back of the hand, against blows.
explain.rule: Motorcycle gloves are approved (omologati): they protect the back of the hand and the palm, give a safe grip and good feel on the controls, and are useful all year.
explain.trap: 'dorso della mano' (back of the hand): the protected part.

sceneParams.caption: Gloves protect the back of the hand

q24438.en: Motorcycle gloves protect the palm of the hand in a fall with sliding on the asphalt.

explain.short: In a fall you slide on your hands. The strong palm of the glove stops scrapes.
explain.rule: Motorcycle gloves are approved (omologati): they protect the back of the hand and the palm, give a safe grip and good feel on the controls, and are useful all year.
explain.trap: 'palmo' (palm): protected against sliding.

sceneParams.caption: Gloves protect the palm on the asphalt

q24439.en: Motorcycle gloves give the right sensitivity while riding and a safer grip on the controls.

explain.short: Good gloves are thin where needed, so you feel the levers and hold the handlebars firmly.
explain.rule: Motorcycle gloves are approved (omologati): they protect the back of the hand and the palm, give a safe grip and good feel on the controls, and are useful all year.
explain.trap: 'presa più sicura' (safer grip): gloves help, they do not get in the way.

sceneParams.caption: Gloves give a safe grip on the controls

q24440.en: Motorcycle gloves can have different padding depending on the season.

explain.short: There are lighter gloves for summer and warmer padded gloves for winter.
explain.rule: Motorcycle gloves are approved (omologati): they protect the back of the hand and the palm, give a safe grip and good feel on the controls, and are useful all year.
explain.trap: 'a seconde della stagione' (depending on the season): summer and winter gloves exist.

sceneParams.caption: Summer and winter gloves exist

q24441.en: When riding a motorcycle, it is advisable to wear proper gloves even in summer.

explain.short: Gloves protect against falls, not only against cold. So wear them in summer too.
explain.rule: Motorcycle gloves are approved (omologati): they protect the back of the hand and the palm, give a safe grip and good feel on the controls, and are useful all year.
explain.trap: 'anche d'estate' (even in summer): protection is needed all year.

sceneParams.caption: Wear motorcycle gloves in summer too
lines: A fall can happen any time

q24442.en: Motorcycle gloves have special fastening systems to stop them slipping off in a fall.

explain.short: A glove that comes off does not protect. Motorcycle gloves close at the wrist so they stay on.
explain.rule: Motorcycle gloves are approved (omologati): they protect the back of the hand and the palm, give a safe grip and good feel on the controls, and are useful all year.
explain.trap: 'sistemi di aggancio' (fastening systems): they keep the glove on.

sceneParams.caption: Glove straps keep them on in a fall

q24443.en: There are no approved motorcycle gloves.

explain.short: Approved motorcycle gloves do exist. They are tested for protection.
explain.rule: Motorcycle gloves are approved (omologati): they protect the back of the hand and the palm, give a safe grip and good feel on the controls, and are useful all year.
explain.trap: 'Non esistono' (there are no): they do exist.

sceneParams.caption: Approved motorcycle gloves exist

q24444.en: Motorcycle gloves can be replaced by ski gloves, but only in the cold season.

explain.short: Ski gloves keep you warm but are not made for falls on asphalt. They do not replace motorcycle gloves.
explain.rule: Motorcycle gloves are approved (omologati): they protect the back of the hand and the palm, give a safe grip and good feel on the controls, and are useful all year.
explain.trap: 'possono essere sostituiti' (can be replaced): ski gloves are not the same.

sceneParams.caption: Ski gloves do not replace motorcycle gloves

q24445.en: If you ride a motorcycle without gloves you can work the controls more quickly.

explain.short: Good motorcycle gloves give a safe grip and good feel. Riding without them does not make you faster, just less protected.
explain.rule: Motorcycle gloves are approved (omologati): they protect the back of the hand and the palm, give a safe grip and good feel on the controls, and are useful all year.
explain.trap: 'più rapidamente' (more quickly): no advantage without gloves.

sceneParams.caption: No gloves does not mean faster reactions

q24446.en: Motorcycle gloves are recognised because they are black with a motorcycle shape printed on the wrist.

explain.short: Colour and pictures mean nothing. Motorcycle gloves are recognised by their approval, not by their look.
explain.rule: Motorcycle gloves are approved (omologati): they protect the back of the hand and the palm, give a safe grip and good feel on the controls, and are useful all year.
explain.trap: 'di colore nero' (black): invented detail.

sceneParams.caption: Gloves are known by approval, not colour

q24447.en: Motorcycle gloves also cover the elbow to give better protection in a fall.

explain.short: Gloves protect hands and wrists. The elbow is protected by the jacket, not by gloves.
explain.rule: Motorcycle gloves are approved (omologati): they protect the back of the hand and the palm, give a safe grip and good feel on the controls, and are useful all year.
explain.trap: 'anche il gomito' (also the elbow): gloves are not that long.

sceneParams.caption: Gloves do not reach the elbow

q24448.en: Motorcycle gloves are not suitable for riding two-wheeled mopeds.

explain.short: Motorcycle gloves are fine on mopeds too. They protect the hands on any two-wheeler.
explain.rule: Motorcycle gloves are approved (omologati): they protect the back of the hand and the palm, give a safe grip and good feel on the controls, and are useful all year.
explain.trap: 'non sono idonei' (not suitable): they are suitable.

sceneParams.caption: Motorcycle gloves are fine on mopeds

q24449.en: The main purpose of motorcycle gloves is to protect from cold, so it is useless to use them in summer.

explain.short: The main job of the gloves is to protect the hands in a fall. So they are useful in summer too.
explain.rule: Motorcycle gloves are approved (omologati): they protect the back of the hand and the palm, give a safe grip and good feel on the controls, and are useful all year.
explain.trap: 'principale scopo' (main purpose): it is protection in falls, not cold.

sceneParams.caption: Gloves protect in falls: wear them in summer

q24450.en: Motorcycle jackets give adequate protection against abrasion when sliding on the asphalt.

explain.short: In a fall you can slide on the road. The jacket's strong material protects the skin from scraping.
explain.rule: Approved motorcycle jackets and clothing resist cuts and abrasion (scraping on asphalt) and have hard protectors at the joints. They exist for every season and in any colour.
explain.trap: 'abrasione' (abrasion, scraping): what the jacket protects against.

sceneParams.caption: Motorcycle jackets protect against scraping

q24451.en: Motorcycle jackets have hard protective inserts at the joints.

explain.short: Shoulders and elbows hit the ground first. Hard protectors in these points absorb the blow.
explain.rule: Approved motorcycle jackets and clothing resist cuts and abrasion (scraping on asphalt) and have hard protectors at the joints. They exist for every season and in any colour.
explain.trap: 'inserti rigidi' (hard inserts): yes, at shoulders and elbows.

sceneParams.caption: Jackets have hard protectors at the joints
lines: Hard protectors on shoulders and elbows

q24452.en: Approved motorcycle clothing is tested for resistance to cuts and to abrasion from impact.

explain.short: To be approved, the clothing must pass tests against cuts and scraping, like in a real fall.
explain.rule: Approved motorcycle jackets and clothing resist cuts and abrasion (scraping on asphalt) and have hard protectors at the joints. They exist for every season and in any colour.
explain.trap: 'taglio e abrasione' (cut and abrasion): these are the real tests.

sceneParams.caption: Approved clothing is tested against cuts

q24453.en: Approved motorcycle clothing is tested for resistance to washing.

explain.short: The approval tests are about safety: cuts and abrasion in a fall. Washing is not part of the approval.
explain.rule: Approved motorcycle jackets and clothing resist cuts and abrasion (scraping on asphalt) and have hard protectors at the joints. They exist for every season and in any colour.
explain.trap: 'lavaggio' (washing): swapped in for 'taglio e abrasione' (cut and abrasion).

sceneParams.caption: Tests are for cuts and abrasion, not washing

q24454.en: Motorcycle jackets are not meant for summer use.

explain.short: There are light, ventilated motorcycle jackets for summer. Protection is needed all year.
explain.rule: Approved motorcycle jackets and clothing resist cuts and abrasion (scraping on asphalt) and have hard protectors at the joints. They exist for every season and in any colour.
explain.trap: 'non sono previste' (not meant): summer jackets exist.

sceneParams.caption: Summer motorcycle jackets exist

q24455.en: To be approved, motorcycle jackets must be only black.

explain.short: Colour has nothing to do with approval. Bright colours even help others see you.
explain.rule: Approved motorcycle jackets and clothing resist cuts and abrasion (scraping on asphalt) and have hard protectors at the joints. They exist for every season and in any colour.
explain.trap: 'unicamente di colore nero' (only black): colour is not a rule.

sceneParams.caption: Approval does not depend on colour
lines: Bright colours help to be seen
